calibration_sources: SGLang RadixAttention / HiRadixCache & vLLM V1 Automatic Prefix Caching (APC) Architecture Papers
NVIDIA Dynamo KV-Aware Router & Mooncake / LMCache Distributed KV Cache Pool Benchmarks
Anthropic Prompt Caching (5m/1h TTL, 90% Read Discount) & DeepSeek / OpenAI Context Caching Economics

workload.agent_trajectory: 20-Turn Coding / Enterprise RAG Agent Session (32K Static Repo/System Prompt + 16K Growing Tool History = 48K Avg Context/Turn)
workload.cluster_scale: 8 Serving Replicas (64xH100/H200 GPUs total) handling 50,000 Agent Sessions/Day (1,000,000 Turns/Day = 48B Input Tokens/Day)
workload.root_causes_of_cache_miss: 1) Injecting dynamic timestamps/UUIDs at the top of system prompts; 2) Round-Robin LB scattering turns across 8 replicas; 3) HBM eviction during user think-time (30-180s)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 无状态全量重算 + 顶部动态时间戳破坏前缀 (0.0% 命中率 ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Stateless Full Recompute + Dynamic Header Timestamp Mutation (0.0% Hit Rate)
tiers.recommended_for: Single-turn unrepeated zero-shot queries only; catastrophic for multi-turn agents (recomputes 960K tokens per 20-turn session).

tiers.name: Tier 2: 普通 Round-Robin 负载均衡 + 单实例 HBM LRU 自动前缀缓存 (仅 14.5% 命中)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Naive Round-Robin Load Balancer + Local HBM LRU Prefix Cache (14.5% Hit Rate)
tiers.recommended_for: Single-instance dev servers; fails in multi-replica production because Round-Robin scatters turns across 8 isolated HBM pools (1/8 hit probability).

tiers.name: Tier 3: 静态前缀置顶规范 + 5m/1h TTL 显式驻留 + Host Pinned DRAM 二级缓存池 (78.5% 命中)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Canonical Static-First Prompt + 5m/1h TTL Pinning + Host Pinned DRAM L2 Pool (78.5% Hit Rate)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard enterprise RAG & API integrations enforcing static-first prompt templates and session-sticky routing with DRAM offload.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 全局 KV 感知前缀树路由 (Dynamo/Mooncake) + 分布式 RDMA KV 池 + 严格追加式 Agent 历史 (94.2% 命中)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Global KV-Aware Radix Router (Dynamo/Mooncake) + Distributed RDMA KV Pool + Append-Only Agent History (94.2% Hit Rate)
tiers.recommended_for: High-scale Coding Agents & multi-turn Agentic workflows: cuts 48K TTFT by 15.35x (2,840 -> 185 ms) and saves $252,000/month (-87.5%).
